what: A revision's diagnostics cannot be held to a clean build's: the driver's `said` is the command's whole standard error (status lines with their times) with each message's `rendered` after it, and the clean build runs only when a check failed. "What a build at width W shows from a record made at V is what a clean build at W shows" is therefore checked with `says` texts typed by hand.
cost: one property stated weaker than it is
cause: `Observed` keeps no field of the diagnostics alone
workaround: `says`, and the in-process test compares every byte
state: open: an `Observed::diagnostics` (the `rendered` of each compiler-message) compared with the clean build's would state it
